static_findings.subject: Offline dialog is downstream of failed processing
static_findings.finding: The wrapper contains a separate continuation returning status 3, and the scheduler checks that status before queuing the internet-required dialog. Normal success follows the actual processing call. Replacing status 3 with success would not perform the omitted work
static_findings.limitation: The exception metadata linking the continuation to a particular thrown type has not been recovered from the two saved sections

static_findings.subject: Engine interface and candidate concrete implementations
static_findings.finding: The wrapper stores an engine interface at object offset 0x38. Its processing path invokes vtable slot 0x48. Shared base-method entries identify candidate derived vtables at RVAs 0x120F728, 0x1212FD8 and 0x1216918
static_findings.limitation: The runtime engine selected for the user's voicebank has not been observed

static_findings.subject: Candidate engine call chains
static_findings.finding: Different engine branches reach lower-level processing or processing-context creation routines; none of the current six runtime edits modifies these engine routines
static_findings.limitation: These are conditional static call paths, not an observed execution trace or proof that every listed routine enforces licensing

static_findings.subject: Obfuscated control flow blocks ordinary decompilation
static_findings.finding: The lower-level routines calculate indirect branch targets using constants in registers, stack slots, and captured read-only data. Ghidra stops or emits incomplete control flow at these branches
static_findings.limitation: No verified local predicate has yet been isolated whose replacement both bypasses the offline restriction and preserves actual synthesis

properties: Uses an absolute non-dot-prefixed Ghidra project path
Passes the console-only logging configuration through JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS
Processes the existing project with -readOnly and -noanalysis
Prints decompiled output to the console; creates no analysis log file
Ghidra may compile its analysis script as part of execution; this does not compile or launch the target application

behavior: Retains exactly the same six runtime edits; no new licensing or rendering branch is bypassed
Adds a vectored observer for Microsoft C++ exception code 0xE06D7363 before suspending application threads
Enables observation only after successful installation of the six edits
Always returns EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH; does not alter the exception, its context, or its handling
Records at most 64 immutable events in a process-memory buffer, with publication markers
Prints thread IDs, the primary mangled exception type when safely readable, throw-info RVAs, and application stack RVAs
Does not read exception-object contents, projects, audio samples, tokens, activation stores, or network payloads
Reads bounded exception type metadata only within the newly created application's main image
Keeps the diagnostic console open while the new application runs and waits for Enter after it exits
Writes no log file; closing the diagnostic console after installation does not intentionally terminate the application
limitations: Diagnostic observation has not been exercised; anti-injection behavior or exception-handler ordering can interfere
Stack walking can be incomplete, and type names can be unavailable
Concurrent or reentrant exceptions may be skipped to avoid recursive collection
First-chance C++ exceptions may be handled normally and are not automatically errors
Only the first 64 captured events are retained; later events require another application session
The memory buffer and observer remain until the application exits; they are not removed while hooks are active
